source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Doctor Doom (Victor von Doom) (archived 30 June 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Sorcery learned from his Roma mother's artifacts, Tibetan monks and Morgan le Fay; he ranks among Earth's strongest spellcasters.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Victor von Doom (Earth-616)

powerOrigins.detail: A self-built, magically forged titanium battle suit gives him tons of lifting strength, heavy protection, force fields, blasters and flight.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Victor von Doom (Earth-616)

powerOrigins.detail: Unpowered, he is a super-genius scientist and a skilled fighter and swordsman, trained by Tibetan monks and master duellists.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Victor von Doom (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Sorcery
abilities.detail: Casts spells to teleport, heal, project force bolts and shields, summon creatures and bind foes with mystic bands.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Victor von Doom (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Super-genius intellect
abilities.detail: One of the top minds on the planet, expert in physics, robotics, genetics and time travel; he built a working time platform.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Victor von Doom (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Battle armour
abilities.detail: His armour lifts several tons, survived a point-blank Infinity Gauntlet blast, and carries electric shocks, force fields and short-range teleportation.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Victor von Doom (Earth-616)
Marvel Fandom wiki: Doctor Doom's Armor

abilities.name: Doombots
abilities.detail: Builds robot doubles of himself with advanced AI, which stand in for him and often explain his apparent deaths.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Victor von Doom (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Mind transference
abilities.detail: A technique learned from the alien Ovoids lets him swap minds with a person he makes eye contact with.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Victor von Doom (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Combat and swordsmanship
abilities.detail: A trained martial artist and master swordsman who has beaten Black Panther and Taskmaster without his armour's help.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Victor von Doom (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Indomitable will
abilities.detail: His willpower is described as the strongest on Earth, letting him resist mental control.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Victor von Doom (Earth-616)

feats.text: Armed with the Silver Surfer's stolen Power Cosmic, he overpowered the Thing and swept aside the whole Fantastic Four.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Fantastic Four Vol 1 58

feats.text: Siphoned Galactus's energy, took the Beyonder's near-limitless power, rebuilt his own ruined body and declared the Secret Wars over.
feats.where: Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars Vol 1 #10 (February 1985)

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars Vol 1 10

feats.text: As God Emperor, he held Battleworld, a planet built from the wreckage of dead realities, together by his will alone.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Secret Wars Vol 1 3
Marvel Fandom wiki: Victor von Doom (Earth-616)

feats.text: Teleported into Bruce Banner's sealed lab two miles underground, forced him into Hulk form and vanished with him, leaving green runes.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Avengers: Endgame
Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Doctor Doom

feats.text: Slipped unseen into the Baxter Building on Earth-828 and knelt before young Franklin Richards as Sue Storm readied her powers.
feats.where: The Fantastic Four: First Steps (2025), mid-credits scene
